Topic.label: Properties of Right Triangles with a 30° Angle

Question:
In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\), \(\angle A=30^\circ\), and \(AB=10\). What is \(BC\)? (Enter a numerical value.)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_140_q1_question_en.svg)
Solution: The leg opposite a \(30^\circ\) angle equals half the hypotenuse, so \(BC=AB\div2=5\).
